newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch ICT to be floated at NLG 23 to 26.
newsitem.headline: Dutch ICT to be floated at NLG 23 to 26.

text.p: Dutch software and services firm ICT Automatisering said on Tuesday its shares will be floated at a price of 23 to 26 guilders.
ICT shareholders plan to sell up to 4,191,474 existing ICT shares. The number could be raised by an additional 628,721 shares to cover over-allotments.
Subscriptions through a bookbuilding procedure will open on June 18 for private and institutional investors and are planned to close on June 30 but may close earlier.

Investment bank MeesPierson, the global coordinator and bookrunner of the flotation, will announce the issue price and allocation of the shares on July 1. This will also be the first day of trading in ICT shares on the Amsterdam bourse.
ICT said in April it would seek a flotation on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange, which would enable the firm to finance future acquisitions.
ICT's 1996 net profit rose by 11.5 percent to 7.2 million guilders on a 12.6 percent higher turnover of 70 million. The company was set up in 1978 and employs 470 people.
